name: com.flighttrackerapi/live-flight-status-airport-schedules-mcp
title: FlightTrackerAPI — Live Flight Status, Delays & Schedules MCP
description: Real-time flight status, live aircraft tracking, airport arrivals/departures, gates, and delays.

tools.name: track_flight_by_callsign
tools.description: Retrieve real-time global ADS-B aircraft telemetry by ATC callsign (e.g. "UAL921", "BAW117"), 6-char ICAO24 hex address, tail registration (e.g. "N663UA"), or 4-digit squawk. Returns live lat/lon, barometric altitude (ft & flight level), groundspeed (kts), track/heading, vertical rate, aircraft type, airline info, and squawk. Cost: 5 Credits / call (0 Credits if not airborne). Data attribution: adsb.lol (ODbL 1.0).

tools.name: get_airspace_flights_nearby
tools.description: Scan all live ADS-B aircraft within a 1–250 nautical mile radius around any lat/lon coordinates or airport IATA/ICAO code (e.g. airport="LHR" or lat=51.47, lon=-0.4543, radius_nm=50). Returns aircraft sorted by distance_nm with live altitude, speed, heading, and airline. Cost: 2 Credits / aircraft returned (0 Credits if empty). Data attribution: adsb.lol (ODbL 1.0).

airport.description: Optional IATA/ICAO airport code (e.g. "LHR", "JFK", "SFO") auto-resolved to lat/lon.

lat.description: Center latitude (-90 to 90), optional if airport code is provided.

lon.description: Center longitude (-180 to 180), optional if airport code is provided.

on_ground.description: Filter by ground/airborne state (true=ground only, false=airborne only).

airline.description: Optional 2-letter IATA or 3-letter ICAO airline filter (e.g. "UAL", "BAW").

tools.name: get_faa_airport_delays
tools.description: Check live FAA National Airspace System operational status including Ground Stops, Ground Delay Programs, Arrival/Departure Delays, and Airport Closures. Pass an optional 3-letter US IATA airport code (e.g. "JFK", "EWR", "MIA", "SFO") or omit for all active US delays nationwide. Cost: 5 Credits / call. Source: FAA NAS Public Domain.

iata.description: Optional 3-letter US IATA airport code (e.g. "JFK", "EWR", "ORD", "MIA"). Omit for all active US delays.

tools.name: lookup_airport_or_airline
tools.description: Instant lookup across 49,000+ global airports and 6,100+ airlines by name, city, IATA code, ICAO code, or country ISO code. Returns exact coordinates, elevation, timezone, ICAO/IATA codes, and airline callsigns. Cost: 2 Credits / call.

airline.description: Airline name, IATA, or ICAO code (e.g. "UAL", "Lufthansa").
